translations.web: For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
translations.bsb: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
translations.kjv: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.
translations.asv: For Jehovah is good; his lovingkindness endureth for ever, And his faithfulness unto all generations. Psalm 101 A Psalm of David.
